definition.scheduled_only: A HAND-STAGED run does NOT count (NEVER rule: validate on the scheduled nightly's artifacts, not ad-hoc). The count advances ONLY on a scheduled-cycle artifact set that all THREE independent passes recorded CLEAN.
definition.reset_rule: An UNEXPLAINED delta in any pass RESETS the streak to 0/3 (PRD:184). A named delta (in DS's ledger) does NOT reset.
definition.no_silent_pass: A scheduled cycle with NO recorded 3-pass verification is NOT counted -- it is a GAP to fill, never a silent pass. Missing verification != clean.
definition.cutover_gate: streak == 3 clean scheduled cycles AND the never-widen co-sign package (CTO+COO+Andrew) -> then S5 cutover (arm publisher, gold->portal). Publisher stays OFF until this fires.
